newsitem.title: INDIA: Dresdner Bank seeks alliance in India.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner Bank seeks alliance in India.

text.p: Germany's Dresdner Bank AG is seeking a strategic alliance in India in the fields of project financing in the power and telecommunications sector, its Asia-Pacific chief said on Friday.

"We are looking for a strategic alliance for project financing in the power and telecom sectors," Rolf Willi, senior general manager and chief executive officier, Asia-Pacific, told reporters in Calcutta.

"We are also opening an office in Delhi, besides the existing one in Bombay," said Willi, who was in Calcutta to attend an international business conference organised by the Confederation of Indian Industry.
